llm_upload.answer_sql:
WITH bonus AS (
  SELECT employee_code, MAX(bonus) AS bonus
  FROM dbpcm_scratch.s_sa34683dcfa924022ad12f4d3ba8c0ba4_upload_e5cf6339b49d4a9b9e6a79892e3d354a
  GROUP BY employee_code
),
earn AS (
  SELECT employee_code, SUM(amount) AS gross_earnings
  FROM dbpcm_datawarehouse.payroll
  WHERE register_type = 'EARN'
    AND pay_date >= toDate('2026-09-01')
    AND pay_date < toDate('2026-10-01')
  GROUP BY employee_code
)
SELECT
  b.employee_code AS `Employee Code`,
  e.employee_name AS `Employee Name`,
  e.department_name AS `Department`,
  COALESCE(n.gross_earnings, 0) AS `September 2026 Gross Earnings`,
  b.bonus AS `Uploaded Bonus`,
  COALESCE(n.gross_earnings, 0) + b.bonus AS `Gross Earnings Plus Bonus`
FROM bonus b
LEFT JOIN earn n ON b.employee_code = n.employee_code
LEFT JOIN dbpcm_datawarehouse.employee e ON b.employee_code = e.employee_code
ORDER BY b.employee_code
